description: This line plot illustrates the "Harmful with Refusal Ratio" across four different vision-language models evaluated on two distinct benchmarks, FigStep and MMSafetyBench, as the input size increases from 128 to 1024. The x-axis represents the input size, labeled "Input Size," and ranges from 128 to 1024, with tick marks at regular intervals of 128. The y-axis represents the "Harmful with Refusal Ratio," scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.5. Four lines are plotted: the blue line with circular markers represents "LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep," starting at approximately 0.20 and rising to about 0.35; the orange line with square markers represents "Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep," beginning near 0.15 and increasing to about 0.41; the green line with triangular markers represents "LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench," starting at approximately 0.07 and rising to about 0.38; and the red line with diamond markers represents "Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench," beginning near 0.24 and rising to about 0.51. All lines show an increasing trend as input size grows, with the red line consistently having the highest ratio and the green line the lowest.
